verdict.rationale:
Typesense's docs explicitly cover custom ranking via a default_sorting_field, boosting/burying sets of records, and dedicated recipes for 'Ranking based on Relevance and Popularity' and 'Ranking based on Relevance and Recency', plus merchandising (promote/hide) controls — directly matching the business-signal ranking story. A community comment independently corroborates the default_sorting_field mechanism as the standard way developers inject custom relevancy scores (e.g., popularity/margin fields) beyond text matching.

missing for 10: no explicit named example for 'margin' as a ranking signal, and no independent hands-on report validating multi-signal ranking blending in production beyond docs and one community mention.
